project.name: TestnizerBank — Eğitim Demo
project.description: Testnizer eğitim/tanıtım demosu. Tüm servisler projedeki Mock sunucularla YEREL çalışır (internet gerekmez): REST + SOAP/WS-Security + GraphQL + SSE + MCP + AI Chat (mock LLM). Başlamadan: Mocks sayfasından 4 sunucuyu Start edin, ortam olarak "🖥️ Lokal Demo" seçin. "06 · Gerçek Zamanlı" klasörü public servislere gider (internet gerekir).

mockServers.name: TestnizerBank API (REST + SOAP + GraphQL)
mockServers.description: Stateful bankacılık mock’u: bakiye transferle gerçekten düşer, iptalle geri gelir (state Start/Stop ile sıfırlanır). /__echo isteği aynen yansıtır. SOAP KYC (XPath koşullu yanıtlar) ve GraphQL de burada.

mockServers.name: Canlı Akış (SSE)
mockServers.description: Server-Sent Events: sonsuz kur akışı, Last-Event-ID ile kaldığı yerden devam eden bildirimler ve ortasında koparak hata veren bir akış.

mockServers.name: AI Asistan (mock LLM)
mockServers.description: OpenAI uyumlu yerel LLM: kelime kelime stream eder. MCP aracı hesap_bakiyesi sunulduysa ve mesajda "bakiye" geçiyorsa aracı çağırır, sonucu cevaplar. model=hata-429 → rate limit hatası. API key gerekmez (herhangi bir değer yazılabilir).

mockEndpoints.description: Chat completions (OpenAI uyumlu) + MCP araç turu
3 olaydan sonra event: error ile kopar
JWKS — login token imza anahtarı (keystore alias tnz-jwt-rs256)
Transfer oluştur — JSON Schema doğrulamalı, idempotent
SOAP 1.1 KYC — XPath koşullu yanıtlar; kimlik zorunlu (zarfta UsernameToken veya HTTP Basic)

const m = /<(?:\w+:)?TCKN>\s*(\d+)\s*</.exec(request.bodyText || '');
response.body = response.body.replace('__TCKN__', m ? m[1] : '');

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<wsdl:definitions name="KycService"
    targetNamespace="http://testnizerbank.local/kyc/v1"
    xmlns:wsdl="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/wsdl/"
    xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/wsdl/soap/"
    xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"
    xmlns:tns="http://testnizerbank.local/kyc/v1">
  <wsdl:types>
    <xsd:schema targetNamespace="http://testnizerbank.local/kyc/v1" elementFormDefault="qualified">
      <xsd:element name="CheckCustomerRequest">
        <xsd:complexType>
          <xsd:sequence>
            <xsd:element name="TCKN" type="xsd:string"/>
            <xsd:element name="FullName" type="xsd:string"/>
            <xsd:element name="Channel" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0"/>
            <xsd:element name="RequestId" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0"/>
          </xsd:sequence>
        </xsd:complexType>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element name="CheckCustomerResponse">
        <xsd:complexType>
          <xsd:sequence>
            <xsd:element name="TCKN" type="xsd:string"/>
            <xsd:element name="Status" type="xsd:string"/>
            <xsd:element name="RiskLevel" type="xsd:string"/>
            <xsd:element name="Reason" type="xsd:string"/>
            <xsd:element name="CheckedAt" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
          </xsd:sequence>
        </xsd:complexType>
      </xsd:element>
    </xsd:schema>
  </wsdl:types>
  <wsdl:message name="CheckCustomerInput">
    <wsdl:part name="parameters" element="tns:CheckCustomerRequest"/>
  </wsdl:message>
  <wsdl:message name="CheckCustomerOutput">
    <wsdl:part name="parameters" element="tns:CheckCustomerResponse"/>
  </wsdl:message>
  <wsdl:portType name="KycPortType">
    <wsdl:operation name="CheckCustomer">
      <wsdl:input message="tns:CheckCustomerInput"/>
      <wsdl:output message="tns:CheckCustomerOutput"/>

  </wsdl:portType>
  <wsdl:binding name="KycBinding" type="tns:KycPortType">
    <soap:binding style="document" transport="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/http"/>

      <wsdl:input><soap:body use="literal"/></wsdl:input>
      <wsdl:output><soap:body use="literal"/></wsdl:output>
    </wsdl:operation>
  </wsdl:binding>
  <wsdl:service name="KycService">
    <wsdl:port name="KycPort" binding="tns:KycBinding">
      <soap:address location="http://127.0.0.1:4010/soap/KycService"/>
